FILE NOTE: SITE MEETING

The site meeting was attended by Cornelius Wetherby and Clementine Ashdown-Vale, and the
surveyor's report was presented by Thaddeus Pembridge. Wilfred Okonkwo joined by telephone
for the last item.

The parties walked the boundary from the gatepost to the hedge. The meeting closed at noon.

Correspondence address for the claimant's solicitors: 40 Moorgate, London EC2R 6EL.

Will and testament matters were not discussed. The fleet car, a Mercedes Benz saloon, stays
at the depot known as Montana Ridge, and no question under the Geneva Convention arises.

The meeting was attended by Robert Ravensworth yesterday. Later Ravensworth said the fence had
moved. The Ravensworth report is attached.
